weekly_updates.summary:
Q3 coverage: management raised full-year adjusted-EPS guidance after 9M like-for-like revenue rose 9.9% to $3.2bn across Performance, Health and Dairy Nutrition (IR/news, early Nov).
Morgan Stanley cut to Underweight (6 Nov), citing intensifying competition and higher contracted whey costs threatening 2027 margins and earnings.
Yahoo quarterly cash flow remains empty; FY2025 OCF $368.5m / FCF ~$284m screen inputs unchanged—TTM FCF still unverified.
